summary: Contestants will compose and format business documents using modern word processing tools, following specified formats from the BPA Style & Reference Manual. All work is completed on-site and uploaded electronically; no printed documents are submitted.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes orientation
no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
no more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
submission_requirements: All student-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Apply foundational formatting skills using modern word processing tools to create business documents
Use editing tools to revise, proofread, and enhance the clarity and accuracy of business documents
Apply paragraph formatting, tab settings, and text enhancements to improve document structure and visual impact
judging_notes: No equipment, supplies, or materials other than those specified for an event will be allowed in the testing area
Previous Business Professionals of America tests (handwritten, photocopied, or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this application event.
